about: Frozen 2026-11-10, BEFORE the 'failed to stop' pointer was added to the Motor Vehicles Act's manifest entry. Long case narratives of the kind a lawyer types, as against the short questions of the gold set. F = a driver hit someone and did not stop or fled (sections 132, 134 and 187 are wanted among the sections handed over); G = no accident (the pointer must not fire). Written by Claude (not a lawyer).
fled: My client is a 41-year-old truck driver from Satara. Around 11 pm on a highway near Pune his truck hit a man who was crossing the road, and the man died on the spot. My client did not stop and drove on, and was traced through the registration number two days later. He has been arrested. What offences is he likely to face? What are the grounds to seek bail?

The complainant says that a white SUV knocked down his father at the market crossing on Tuesday evening and sped away without stopping; the father died in hospital. The police have traced my client, the owner, who says his driver was at the wheel. What are my client's exposures and how do I defend him?

Last month my client, a bus driver, hit a motorcyclist at a toll plaza. The rider was badly injured. In panic my client left the spot and surrendered only the next morning at the police station. Which provisions will apply and what is the position on bail?

A tempo hit two schoolchildren near a village school and the driver fled into the fields. He was caught by villagers an hour later and handed over to the police. One child died. Advise the driver's family on the charges and on bail.

My client was riding a motorcycle at night, hit an elderly woman who was crossing, and rode away without checking on her. She suffered a fracture. He is now in custody. Which sections apply and what are the grounds for bail?
others: My client, an accountant, is accused of falsifying the bank's loan records. He was arrested last week. What offences apply and how do I get him bail?
A truck driver was arrested because the truck was carrying banned gutka without the owner's knowledge. What are the grounds for bail?
My client, a taxi driver, is accused of assaulting a passenger over the fare during the trip. He was arrested yesterday. What offences are likely and what are the bail grounds?
